items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Well, I did an album for Joe Henry. He told me in Germany that he wanted to record me, and I played on a show with his band.

ctx.x: Beautiful song. You recorded as recently as two years ago.
Well, I did an album for Joe Henry. He told me in Germany that he wanted to record me, and I played on a show with his band. We played it in Germany...
